messages.content: What is assistant-only masking?
It calculates loss only on assistant response tokens while ignoring prompt and padding tokens.
Does ArcLM support GPU training?
Yes, ArcLM supports GPU acceleration through PyTorch.
Can ArcLM run on CPU?
Yes, although training and inference are generally slower on CPU than on GPU.
What is a tokenizer?
A tokenizer converts text into token IDs that a language model can process.
What does the vocabulary size represent?
It represents the total number of unique tokens that the tokenizer can produce.
What is a token?
A token is a piece of text, such as a word, subword, or character, represented by an integer ID.
What is sequence length?
Sequence length is the number of tokens processed together in one input sequence.
Why are embeddings used?
Embeddings convert discrete token IDs into continuous vectors that the model can learn from.
What is dropout?
Dropout randomly disables some neurons during training to reduce overfitting.
What does LayerNorm do?
Layer normalization stabilizes training by normalizing activations within each layer.

conversations.value: What is a causal language model?
A causal language model predicts the next token using only previous tokens.
What does nn.Embedding do?
It maps token IDs to trainable dense vectors.
Why are positional embeddings needed?
They provide information about token order because attention alone is permutation invariant.
What does the output head produce?
It projects hidden representations into vocabulary-sized logits for next-token prediction.
What are logits?
Logits are unnormalized prediction scores for every token in the vocabulary.

messages.content: Why is padding used?
Padding makes all sequences in a batch the same length for efficient tensor operations.
What is a training epoch?
An epoch is one complete pass through the entire training dataset.
What is gradient descent?
Gradient descent updates model parameters to minimize the training loss.
Why is validation important?
Validation measures how well the model generalizes to unseen data during training.
What does get_num_parameters() return?
It returns the total number of trainable and non-trainable parameters in the model.

conversations.value: What is overfitting?
Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes training data instead of learning general patterns.
Why use PyTorch?
PyTorch provides automatic differentiation, GPU support, and flexible neural network development.
What does a tokenizer output?
A tokenizer outputs integer token IDs representing the input text.
What is next-token prediction?
Next-token prediction is the task of predicting the most likely token that follows the current context.
What is the purpose of language model training?
Training teaches the model statistical patterns in language so it can predict future tokens.
